rows: - Runs 40233005896 (5ff4263e7) and 40235904669 (6ad8a4923): `service-e2e-tests` failed both times in `crate-wf-harness:cargo-integration`, the same two journeys (`an_attached_session_proxies_stubs_and_forwards_network_and_feeds_fake_media`, `an_attached_session_reads_pages_and_manages_its_lifecycle`) with `page.goto ... did not finish loading within 30 s`; the other 11 wf-harness journeys, the wf-bench journey and the wf visual journey passed. The two failures sat in the window where the wf-bench and wf binaries also ran a Chromium: Nx ran the three integration crates in parallel (`--parallel=4`) and the Chromium gate is per process.
